title: Test Movie: clicking Play button on title screen does not advance to game level
description:
Investigation findings (2026-06-10): The 'Ruffle instance destroyed + two new SWF blobs loaded' observation was a false alarm from HMR (hot-module reload) firing while the 0907 agent was simultaneously editing source files during QA testing — not caused by clicking the Play button.

Architecture finding: The Play button (symbol-32) has NO buttonActions defined. Game navigation uses the 'ballmask' MovieClip transition pattern: frame scripts assign onRelease handlers that set _root.ballmask.tgt = 'AA1' (or another label) then call _root.ballmask.play(), which plays a mask animation and at the end calls _root.gotoAndStop(tgt).

Frame scripts on Scene AA include: _root.gotoAndPlay('menu') on Walls frame 52 (back-to-menu); _root.pos = SharedObject.getLocal('magsaveAA') on frame 0 (persistent progress). The title screen is Scene 5 (frame label 'menu').

Closing as cannot-reproduce-as-filed. A proper Playwright E2E test specifically for the Play button (without concurrent file edits) would be needed to confirm if ballmask transitions work correctly at runtime.
